stem: A website's icon buttons measure 16 by 16 CSS pixels. Which WCAG 2.2 Level AA check applies?

options.text: Target Size (Minimum) requires 24 by 24 CSS pixels or enough spacing.
options.rationale: WCAG 2.2 sets a 24 by 24 CSS pixel minimum, with a spacing exception for undersized targets.

options.text: Contrast (Minimum) requires at least 4.5:1 between the icon and its background.
options.rationale: Contrast affects the icon's visibility, not its target size; both can matter, but size is the check asked about.

options.text: Resize Text requires the icon to grow to 200% with the page text.
options.rationale: Resize Text concerns text, not the target size of a control.

options.text: Focus Visible requires the icon to show a 2-pixel outline.
options.rationale: Focus Visible concerns the focus indicator, not the target's dimensions.

explanation: WCAG 2.2 Success Criterion 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum) sets a Level AA minimum of 24 by 24 CSS pixels for pointer targets, with exceptions such as sufficient spacing, inline links, and controls whose size is set by the user agent. A 16 by 16 target is below that minimum unless an exception applies.

references.title: W3C WAI — Understanding Success Criterion 2.5.8: Target Size (Minimum)

author: Oxypteros
